attribute_fields.COMMENTS: New Mexico state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with LICTR per NM tax code (2025). Source: NM TRD. Skeleton table: only the HOH filing-status condition is populated as real EL; remaining conditions, all actions, and the 6-bracket calculation plus LICTR rebate are intentionally empty pending authorship. Constants exist in NM_edd.xml. See issue #446.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.nm_limit_1 = nm_single_bracket_1_limit; set result.nm_limit_2 = nm_single_bracket_2_limit; set result.nm_limit_3 = nm_single_bracket_3_limit; set result.nm_limit_4 = nm_single_bracket_4_limit; set result.nm_high_base = nm_single_high_base; set result.nm_top_threshold = nm_single_bracket_5_limit; set result.nm_top_base = nm_single_top_base; set result.nm_lmi_limit = nm_lmi_limit_single; set result.nm_lmi_base = nm_lmi_base_single; set result.nm_lmi_rate = nm_lmi_rate_single; set result.nm_dependent_deduction = 0.0
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: nm_single_bracket_1_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_1 xdef nm_single_bracket_2_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_2 xdef nm_single_bracket_3_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_3 xdef nm_single_bracket_4_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_4 xdef nm_single_high_base cvd /result.nm_high_base xdef nm_single_bracket_5_limit cvd /result.nm_top_threshold xdef nm_single_top_base cvd /result.nm_top_base xdef nm_lmi_limit_single cvd /result.nm_lmi_limit xdef nm_lmi_base_single cvd /result.nm_lmi_base xdef nm_lmi_rate_single cvd /result.nm_lmi_rate xdef 0.0 cvd /result.nm_dependent_deduction xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: MFJ or Head of Household: joint brackets and the line 13 dependent deduction
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "HOH"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "HOH" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Surviving Spouse: joint brackets, no line 13 deduction

action_details.action_comment: Married Filing Jointly / Surviving Spouse / Head of Household column
action_details.action_dsl: set result.nm_limit_1 = nm_joint_bracket_1_limit; set result.nm_limit_2 = nm_joint_bracket_2_limit; set result.nm_limit_3 = nm_joint_bracket_3_limit; set result.nm_limit_4 = nm_joint_bracket_4_limit; set result.nm_high_base = nm_joint_high_base; set result.nm_top_threshold = nm_joint_bracket_5_limit; set result.nm_top_base = nm_joint_top_base; set result.nm_lmi_limit = nm_lmi_limit_joint; set result.nm_lmi_base = nm_lmi_base_joint; set result.nm_lmi_rate = nm_lmi_rate_joint
action_details.action_postfix: nm_joint_bracket_1_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_1 xdef nm_joint_bracket_2_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_2 xdef nm_joint_bracket_3_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_3 xdef nm_joint_bracket_4_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_4 xdef nm_joint_high_base cvd /result.nm_high_base xdef nm_joint_bracket_5_limit cvd /result.nm_top_threshold xdef nm_joint_top_base cvd /result.nm_top_base xdef nm_lmi_limit_joint cvd /result.nm_lmi_limit xdef nm_lmi_base_joint cvd /result.nm_lmi_base xdef nm_lmi_rate_joint cvd /result.nm_lmi_rate xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.nm_limit_1 = nm_mfs_bracket_1_limit; set result.nm_limit_2 = nm_mfs_bracket_2_limit; set result.nm_limit_3 = nm_mfs_bracket_3_limit; set result.nm_limit_4 = nm_mfs_bracket_4_limit; set result.nm_high_base = nm_mfs_high_base; set result.nm_top_threshold = nm_mfs_bracket_5_limit; set result.nm_top_base = nm_mfs_top_base; set result.nm_lmi_limit = nm_lmi_limit_mfs; set result.nm_lmi_base = nm_lmi_base_mfs; set result.nm_lmi_rate = nm_lmi_rate_mfs
action_details.action_postfix: nm_mfs_bracket_1_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_1 xdef nm_mfs_bracket_2_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_2 xdef nm_mfs_bracket_3_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_3 xdef nm_mfs_bracket_4_limit cvd /result.nm_limit_4 xdef nm_mfs_high_base cvd /result.nm_high_base xdef nm_mfs_bracket_5_limit cvd /result.nm_top_threshold xdef nm_mfs_top_base cvd /result.nm_top_base xdef nm_lmi_limit_mfs cvd /result.nm_lmi_limit xdef nm_lmi_base_mfs cvd /result.nm_lmi_base xdef nm_lmi_rate_mfs cvd /result.nm_lmi_rate xdef

action_details.action_comment: Line 13: $4,000 per dependent after the first
action_details.action_dsl: set result.nm_dependent_deduction = (the maximum of (length of job.dependents - 1) and 0) * nm_dependent_deduction_amount
action_details.action_postfix: job.dependents length 1 - 0 max nm_dependent_deduction_amount fmul cvd /result.nm_dependent_deduction xdef

action_details.action_comment: Line 12 federal standard deduction; line 14 low- and middle-income exemption worksheet, rounded to the dollar
action_details.action_dsl: set result.nm_std_deduction = result.standard_deduction; set result.nm_exemptions = length of job.taxpayers + length of job.dependents; if result.state_calc_agi <= result.nm_lmi_limit then { set result.nm_lmi_exemption = the floor of ((the maximum of (nm_low_middle_income_exemption - result.nm_lmi_rate * (the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.nm_lmi_base) and 0.0)) and 0.0) * result.nm_exemptions + 0.5); } else { set result.nm_lmi_exemption = 0.0; } endif
action_details.action_postfix: result.standard_deduction cvd /result.nm_std_deduction xdef job.taxpayers length job.dependents length + cvd /result.nm_exemptions xdef { nm_low_middle_income_exemption result.nm_lmi_rate result.state_calc_agi result.nm_lmi_base f- 0.0 fmax fmul f- 0.0 fmax result.nm_exemptions fmul 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.nm_lmi_exemption xdef } { 0.0 cvd /result.nm_lmi_exemption xdef } result.state_calc_agi result.nm_lmi_limit f<= ifelse

action_details.action_comment: Line 17 taxable income; line 18 tax from the rate table
action_details.action_dsl: set result.nm_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.nm_std_deduction - result.nm_dependent_deduction - result.nm_lmi_exemption) and 0.0; perform NM_Tax_Table; set result.nm_tax = result.nm_table_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.nm_std_deduction f- result.nm_dependent_deduction f- result.nm_lmi_exemption f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.nm_taxable_income xdef /NM_Tax_Table performtable result.nm_table_tax cvd /result.nm_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Harvested onto the roster by Compute_Roster_State_Tax
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.nm_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.nm_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.nm_taxable_income cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.nm_tax cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: add " New Mexico (PIT-1 2025): taxable income $" + result.nm_taxable_income + " (standard deduction $" + result.nm_std_deduction + ", dependents $" + result.nm_dependent_deduction + ", low/middle-income exemption $" + result.nm_lmi_exemption + "), tax $" + result.nm_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " New Mexico (PIT-1 2025): taxable income $" result.nm_taxable_income strconcat " (standard deduction $" strconcat result.nm_std_deduction strconcat ", dependents $" strconcat result.nm_dependent_deduction strconcat ", low/middle-income exemption $" strconcat result.nm_lmi_exemption strconcat "), tax $" strconcat result.nm_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: New Mexico military retirement exclusion calculation. NM allows up to $30,000 exemption on military retirement pay for 2025-2026. Honors MSRRA and SCRA per federal law. Source: MOAA State Report Card. Skeleton table: needs authorship. Conditions/actions intentionally empty pending follow-up; nm_military_retirement_exemption is declared in NM_edd.xml but exclusion logic is not wired up. See issue #446.

initial_action.initial_action_postfix: result.nm_taxable_income 100.0 fdiv ceiling 100.0 fmul 50.0 f- cvd /result.nm_band_midpoint xdef

action_details.action_comment: Bracket tax at the band midpoint, rounded
action_details.action_dsl: set result.nm_table_tax = the floor of (nm_bracket_1_rate * (the minimum of result.nm_band_midpoint and result.nm_limit_1) + nm_bracket_2_rate * (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.nm_band_midpoint and result.nm_limit_2) - result.nm_limit_1) and 0.0) + nm_bracket_3_rate * (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.nm_band_midpoint and result.nm_limit_3) - result.nm_limit_2) and 0.0) + nm_bracket_4_rate * (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.nm_band_midpoint and result.nm_limit_4) - result.nm_limit_3) and 0.0) + nm_bracket_5_rate * (the maximum of (result.nm_band_midpoint - result.nm_limit_4) and 0.0) + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: nm_bracket_1_rate result.nm_band_midpoint result.nm_limit_1 fmin fmul nm_bracket_2_rate result.nm_band_midpoint result.nm_limit_2 fmin result.nm_limit_1 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ nm_bracket_3_rate result.nm_band_midpoint result.nm_limit_3 fmin result.nm_limit_2 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ nm_bracket_4_rate result.nm_band_midpoint result.nm_limit_4 fmin result.nm_limit_3 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ nm_bracket_5_rate result.nm_band_midpoint result.nm_limit_4 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.nm_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.nm_table_tax = the floor of (result.nm_high_base + nm_bracket_5_rate * (result.nm_taxable_income - nm_table_limit) + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.nm_high_base nm_bracket_5_rate result.nm_taxable_income nm_table_limit f- fmul f+ 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.nm_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Page T-7: base + 5.9% over the threshold
action_details.action_dsl: set result.nm_table_tax = the floor of (result.nm_top_base + nm_bracket_6_rate * (result.nm_taxable_income - result.nm_top_threshold) + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.nm_top_base nm_bracket_6_rate result.nm_taxable_income result.nm_top_threshold f- fmul f+ 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.nm_table_tax xdef
